org.smtlib.AbstractSolver

Packages that use AbstractSolver
Package
Description
org.smtlib.solvers
This package implements various instances of org.smtlib.ISolver, which are specific solvers that wrap and interact with various off-the-shelf SMT solvers currently available.

  • Uses of AbstractSolver in org.smtlib.solvers

    Subclasses of AbstractSolver in org.smtlib.solvers
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    Solver_altergo
    This class is a FIRST-PASS, CI-UNVERIFIED adapter for Alt-Ergo (2.6.3).
    class 
    Solver_bitwuzla
    This class is an adapter for Bitwuzla (bit-vectors, floating-point, arrays and uninterpreted functions -- no arithmetic logics, no datatypes).
    class 
    Solver_cvc5
    This class is an adapter for cvc5, on the assumption that it is (or should be) a fully SMT-LIB compliant solver: it is a concrete, silent inheritor of AbstractSolver — only the startup command line (cvc5 needs --incremental to accept push/pop at all, and --quiet to suppress informational stderr chatter that would otherwise fool SolverProcess's stdout/stderr-preference heuristic) and Solver_cvc5.start() (process lifecycle) are overridden.
    class 
    Solver_smt
    This class is an adapter that takes the SMT-LIB ASTs and translates them into SMT commands over a solver process speaking plain SMT-LIB, for a solver assumed to be fully SMT-LIB compliant.
    class 
    Solver_smtinterpol
    This class is an adapter for SMTInterpol (a Java SMT solver launched as java -jar smtinterpol-VERSION.jar, not a native executable): it is a concrete, silent inheritor of AbstractSolver -- the base launch command is declared in jsmtlib.properties via org.smtlib.solver_smtinterpol-2.5.command (see SMT.startSolver's %exec% placeholder substitution), so only the conditional timeout flag and Solver_smtinterpol.start()/exit() (process lifecycle) are handled here.
    class

    This class is an adapter that takes the SMT-LIB ASTs and translates them into Z3 commands

    Solver_z3_4_3
    This class is an adapter that takes the SMT-LIB ASTs and translates them into Z3 commands
    class 
    Solver_z3_4_3_2
    This is a special handler for Z3 4.3.2, as opposed to other revisions of Z3 4.3.
    class 
    Solver_z3_recent
    This class is an adapter for recent z3 versions (empirically verified against 4.8.12 and 4.10.2), on the assumption that they are (or should be) fully SMT-LIB compliant: it is a concrete, silent inheritor of AbstractSolver -- only the startup command line and Solver_z3_recent.start()/exit() (process lifecycle) are overridden.
